james.3.p1.b1.text: Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.

james.3.p1.b2.text: We all stumble in many ways.

james.3.p1.b3.text: If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.

james.3.p2.b1.text: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.

james.3.p2.b2.text: Consider ships as well. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot is inclined.

james.3.p3.b1.text: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things.

james.3.p3.b2.text: Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.

james.3.p3.b3.text: The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person …

james.3.p3.b4.text: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed … but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

james.3.p4.b1.text: With the tongue we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.

james.3.p4.b2.text: Out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, this should not be!

james.3.p4.b3.text: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?

james.3.p4.b4.text: My brothers, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.

james.3.p5.b1.text: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.

james.3.p5.b2.text: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.

james.3.p5.b3.text: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.

james.3.p5.b4.text: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
